subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Digital Product Passports
description: A 60-second lesson on Digital Product Passports.

hook.text: Scan a QR code on a shirt. See where the cotton was grown, who sewed it, and how to recycle it.

buildup.text: Digital product passports store a product's lifecycle data: materials, origin, carbon footprint, and recyclability.

discovery.text: They enable circular economy by giving recyclers the information they need to recover materials properly.

twist.text: Creating passports requires every supply chain partner to share data—a coordination challenge at global scale.

climax.text: The EU will require digital product passports for batteries, textiles, and electronics starting in 2027.

punchline.text: Every product tells a story. The passport makes it readable.

quiz.question: What information does a digital product passport contain?
options: Materials, origin, carbon footprint, and recyclability
